site.name: DepthGlow
site.tagline: Cinematic AI sites that glow. Copy a prompt, paste it into your AI, launch a site that doesn't look AI-made.

templates.title: Japan Island Jelly
templates.blurb: A miniature shrine island you can orbit: torii standing in the tide, cherry blossoms, living shoreline and a full editorial layout - one HTML file, no assets. FREE quality baseline for 3D, 2D, animation, UI/UX and typography.

templates.title: Ocean Shallows
templates.blurb: A living tropical sea in a single file: GPU ripples, manta rays and moon jellies you can throw, drag and release - creature counter, synth surf, zero assets. FREE quality baseline.

templates.title: Ghost Pirate Ship
templates.blurb: A spectral pirate ship crossing a moonlit sea — glowing green hull, skeletal crew, Gerstner waves and click-fire broadsides. Fully procedural, pure atmosphere.

templates.title: Cutaway Classroom
templates.blurb: A 3D cutaway science lesson in one file: water flows through fish gills or lungs, numbered callouts track the model, 5-step timeline. Bright, tactile, zero assets.

templates.title: Frame Walk Gallery
templates.blurb: Scroll a museum row of nine procedural artworks, click any frame to dolly in, switch the whole gallery from straight wall to curved arc. Brass UI, pure canvas art.

templates.title: Harukaze Station
templates.blurb: A low-poly Japanese countryside platform where petals fall, trains arrive and seasons repaint the world - spring, summer, autumn, winter plus noon-to-night lighting.

templates.title: Isoglow Lab
templates.blurb: An isometric neon data-city with a live equalizer, ring transmitters and swarm cloud - every tower you press answers back. Four themes, terrain swap, terminal UI.

templates.title: Particle Swarm
templates.blurb: 14,000 GPU particles snap between sphere, torus knot and helix with spring physics - throw it between Drift and Storm, click to send a shockwave through the cloud.

templates.title: Pelagia Railway
templates.blurb: A tropical island miniature with a vintage railway diving through a transparent underwater tunnel - day/night, rain, loco swap and a cutaway reveal of the whole line.

templates.title: Reef Lagoon
templates.blurb: Throw sharks, turtles, dolphins and mantas off a dock into a top-down lagoon - per-species ballistics, GPU ripples, foam, plus reef themes, weather and camera layouts.
